summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes 16-23 m away and steep grade.
reasons: Homes about 16 m away, own side

drivers.seclusion: Nearest homes 16 m, 23 m and 31 m on the south side; trees and shrubs screen yards.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a kerbside lane where a car is parked; no signs, so legal to stop.
drivers.convention: A car or two parked along the kerb, but no clear parking convention.

flags: Steep: about 7% over 20 m, up to 11.6% overall
House 10 m away from 29 m onwards
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tree canopy, mainly from the north-east.

best_section.where: Julie Street south kerb, uphill end beside the vegetated yards
